summary: de-minimal also has eda.builtin.range and eda.builtin.webhook; AWS CloudTrail, SQS and Azure Service Bus sources moved to amazon.aws.aws_cloudtrail, amazon.aws.aws_sqs_queue and azure.azcollection.azure_service_bus in de-supported, and ansible.eda.file, file_watch, journald, tick and url_check are unsupported and will be removed.
questions: Which EDA event sources are deprecated or will be removed?
Where is the Azure Service Bus event source now?

answer_card.title: EDA event source renames and removals
answer_card.answer_md:
Move to the `de-supported` names:

| New (de-supported) | Deprecated (de-minimal) |
|---|---|
| `amazon.aws.aws_cloudtrail` | `ansible.eda.aws_cloudtrail` |
| `amazon.aws.aws_sqs_queue` | `ansible.eda.aws_sqs_queue` |
| `azure.azcollection.azure_service_bus` | `ansible.eda.azure_service_bus` |

Also renamed: `eda.builtin.range` and `eda.builtin.webhook`.

Unsupported and to be removed: `ansible.eda.file`, `file_watch`, `journald`, `tick`, `url_check`.
